We've heard your recent questions regarding the matchmaking logic we shared here in 2022.

notes.title: Concerns regarding balancing
notes.content:
[h1]Concerns regarding balancing[/h1]
This post is here to clarify us saying we will downgrade people with buildings that aren't made for their starbase, like having Compact Houses lvl 9 or 10 on your a sb5 planet.

The reason for this is to make the game more fair, since people who would have a maxed planet before the update have a direct benefit over people who don't.

We have heard concerns that there is a lot of free loot at starbase 5 that is not really obtainable when upgrading to higher starbases, which we will take in account when reworking attacks for Unreal. But more info on that in the future!

[h2]Why rebalance this anyway?[/h2]
We disagree that having the option to have max houses/banks at starbase 5 is good game design, as their is no real incentive to upgrade on colonies besides that. Obviously this woul'dve changed in the future anyway, with releases such as new starbase levels (omg starbase 10 mention).

We have seen your feedback though and in response we have brought down the costs of troops and buffed income of lower level houses.
We will continue to monitor our balancing and see if that was enough!

[h2]When?[/h2]
Seeing as this change was apparently more controversial as we thought, we will give you **at least 6 months** before we do this change.
More likely this will just be done when we port Flash data over to Unreal though, so you will have enough time.

We will mention it once we get closer though, so it doesn't take you by surprise.

[h2]Avatar Reminder[/h2]
We have entirely disabled gravatar support for avatars in-game, in favor of our own system.
Upload your custom avatar here: https://accounts.phoenixnetwork.net/account/information.

[b]Note:[/b] Any NSFW pictures will be moderated and removed, offenders can be banned.

notes.title: Galaxy Life game status
notes.content:
For the past few days, we've been blown away by the unexpected hype that followed the release of Galaxy Life open beta. Unfortunately, all of our servers are heavily overloaded due to the large number of players that have attempted to join over the past few days, and they have gone down multiple times during this. We have been working hard towards resolving these issues and will continue doing so until they're fixed. We ask that everyone do their best to remain patient during this open beta period as we continuously improve it to bring you the best gaming experience possible.

The servers will be turned off within the next half hour or so, and the servers will remain offline while we work out some major bugs. You can stay updated in our [url=https://discord.gg/galaxylife]Discord server[/url] and be notified when the servers come back online.


[h1]Frequently Asked Questions:[/h1]

[h2]Will we lose any progress made so far during the beta?[/h2]
No, any progress made so far will remain. We also plan to keep the progress from the open beta when we fully release the game. However, it's unlikely but possible that there will be a critical issue with player data that will require a wipe right before the full release.

[h2]If there happens to be a data reset, what happens to the chips I purchased?[/h2]
If there is a wipe, any chips purchased through Steam will automatically be added back to your inventory after the wipe.

[h2]I can't connect. It keeps giving me the error "Server unreachable".[/h2]
The servers are currently heavily overloaded. As said above, we're working on a fix.

[h2]I found a bug. What should I do?[/h2]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/galaxylife]Discord server[/url] and send a message to Galaxy Life ModMail#9864 describing the bug and providing photos and videos if possible.

[h2]How do I add friends?[/h2]
Currently, you can only add players that are on your Steam friends list. You can add friends by pressing the invite tab at the top of your screen. Here it'll display all your Steam friends and give you the option to invite them. If none of your Steam friends appear, restart the game from Steam as it did not properly load your friends.
